arriving cell per call; scalar arithmetic intermediates not byte-bounded
returned receipt rows per batch, including stale timers

memory_scope.boundary_graph: Shared observers/latest packet, executor and mapping shells, backend/queue controls, cells, pending features, timers and returned batches. Shared roots charged in full to each arm; physical roots deduplicated.
memory_scope.harness: Input tape and operation schedule, frozen reference/Meter/journal, accumulated receipts, snapshots, hashes, reports, graph root assembly and recursive walker seen-set/children scratch. Never charged as zero-cost deployment work.
memory_scope.returned_buffers: Returned dict/list/row objects and referenced packets remain live until consumed and released by caller; sampled immediately after each call. Retained diagnostic histories are harness-owned.
memory_scope.unknown: Unobserved intra-call overlap, allocation capacity changes, Python frames/iterators/generators/arithmetic temporaries, allocator arenas, interpreter/library/native memory and RSS. Structural item ceilings are not a complete transient byte bound.

work_scope: External service volumes preserve the old typed counts. The old journal is reference-harness work. New validation, wrapper, return-buffer and interpreter costs are not measured CPU instructions or a complete new operation vector.
